result.plan:
{"how": "1. Gather materials:
   • Wood handle – about 60–70 cm long.
   • Metal blade – steel plate roughly 10×15 cm.
   • Iron rivets or bolts for attachment.

2. Prepare the wood handle:
   • Cut to length; sand smooth.
   • Drill holes near each end for bolt placement.

3. Shape the metal blade:
   • Heat‑treat if possible to harden edges.
   • File into a sharp edge suitable for chopping.

4. Attach blade to handle:
   • Align holes; insert iron rivet through handle hole and blade slot.
   • Tighten securely using a hammer or wrench.

5. Finish touches:
   • Polish metal surface.
   • Apply protective oil to wooden handle.
   • Test balance and grip.
", "what": "Create a functional axe usable for cutting tasks.", "why": "This method uses readily available resources and standard joinery techniques ensuring durability while keeping construction straightforward."}
